text: Dynamic regulation is the antithesis of static, stable, and presumptively optimal regulation, and it is intended to counterbalance the effects of stable and presumptively optimal rules rather than replace them.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2273857

isBasedOn.name: Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry

abstract: Dynamic regulation may be seen as the antithesis of static, stable, and presumptively "optimal" regulation and it may help counterbalance the effects of stable and presumptively optimal rules.
